item.text:
This pass strengthened the protocol fuzz with the two election-safety invariants it was missing.

**Added invariants**

The 3/5-node fuzz (message loss, reordering, partitions, ~700 proposals and ~20 leader terms per seed) now also checks, at every observation point:

- a node never changes its vote within a term (the classic double-voting safety violation), and
- a leader always voted for itself in its term.

All 20 runs pass with these checks: no logged term ever contains two different votes from the same node, and every observed leader had voted for itself. That closes the remaining Raft safety property the fuzz did not previously assert (leader uniqueness, log matching and commit monotonicity were already checked).

**State**

Three findings, unchanged, all reproduced and all fixed in `audit/diag-fixes/` with no regressions:

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) misses the engine wakeup.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`.

The negative-result catalogue now covers election safety (vote uniqueness, leader self-vote), leader uniqueness, log matching, commit monotonicity, liveness after healing, in-memory log modelling, crash-restart vote safety, entry encoding, follower/observer/witness behaviour, leader transfer, large payloads, restart endurance with snapshots, linearizability under concurrency (single and cross-node) and multi-cluster isolation.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (580 lines) records the extended invariants; the updated fuzz is mirrored into the fix-verification copy. Implementation remains byte-identical to `../source`.
